Kit summary

Order of FlameBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals DMG by 3.8% of Rudi's Max HP to a single enemy. Meanwhile, deals extra DMG by 3.8% of the target's Max HP, caps at 11% of Rudi's Max HP. The extra DMG is considered as [HP Burning] DMG.
Fire Staff Lv.2Order of Flame: Also attacks up to 2 enemies with [HP Burning] other than the main target.
Fire TornadoActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals DMG by 10% of Rudi's Max HP to all enemies, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] on them for 2 turns.
Fire Staff Lv.1Fire Tornado: Additionally deals DMG by 6% of the targets' Max HP, caps at 18% of Rudi's Max HP. This DMG is considered as [HP Burning] DMG.
Flame ComboPassive
When Rudi casts Order of Flame proactively, there is a 80% fixed chance to pursue and attack for once. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.
Formation of Raging FlameActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals DMG by 20% of Rudi's Max HP to all enemies. If the target's Turn Meter is less than 50%, there is a 40% chance to inflict [Imprison] for 1 turn; if not, there is a 40% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn.
Fire Staff Lv.3Formation of Raging Flame: The chance of inflicting [Imprison] and [Silence] +25%.
